name: University of Padua
summary: Public university in Padua, near Venice; seven English bachelor's, all with capped places and an EU call in March–April 2027, plus Medicine via IMAT.

handoff.label: Study in English: how to apply

ib.text: A school diploma after 12 years, finished by 31 July 2027. Most English bachelor's rank you on the CEnT-S test; the two psychology degrees use their own online test in English.

dates.label: Diploma must be completed (you can apply before you have it)

programmes.name: Animal Care
programmes.about: Professional care, husbandry and welfare of animals, with field visits to zoos, rehabilitation centres and research facilities, at the Agripolis campus near Padua.
programmes.overview: The degree centres on the care of animals and their welfare, looking at the individual animal as well as themes that run across species, alongside scientific research and the conservation of terrestrial and aquatic environments. Typical courses in such a degree include biology, anatomy and physiology, animal behaviour, nutrition and welfare. Learning is practical, with field visits to zoos, rehabilitation centres and research facilities and internships that can be done abroad. Graduates work in animal protection and monitoring and in coordinating care alongside veterinarians, biologists and zoologists, and the international outlook supports study for a master's outside Italy.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test; good maths, physics, biology and chemistry expected. EU call 9 March–9 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Capped places filled from a ranking; see the programme's call when it opens. 37 places for EU applicants (2027/28).
programmes.closesNote: Programme page: 9 April; general page: 7 April
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €2,950 a year, by income

programmes.name: Biology of Human and Environmental Health
programmes.about: A joint degree with the University of Bologna on how human health and the environment interact; two years in Padua, then a Human Health (Padua) or Environmental Health (Bologna) path.
programmes.overview: You study the biological processes that keep the human body working, how changes in them lead to disease, and how people and their environment affect one another, including the effects of human activity and global environmental change on health. Typical early courses in a biology degree include chemistry, genetics, cell biology, physiology and statistics, and advanced research methods are woven through the programme. The first two years are in Padua, then you take a Human Health path in Padua or an Environmental Health path in Bologna. Graduates go on to master's study in the biological and biomedical sciences.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test. EU call one 9 March–9 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Capped places filled from a ranking; see the programme's call when it opens. 75 places for EU applicants (2027/28).
programmes.closesNote: Programme page: 9 April; general page: 7 April
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €2,950 a year, by income

programmes.name: Earth and Climate Dynamics
programmes.about: Earth system science across solid Earth, oceans, climate, atmosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere, mixing classroom teaching with field work.
programmes.overview: The degree gives advanced training in Earth science with modern techniques: remote sensing, satellite data processing, geographic information systems, drone technology and basic modelling, applied to climate change. Classroom teaching is combined with practical activities, and typical courses in an Earth science degree include geology, geophysics, mineralogy, oceanography and atmospheric science, with fieldwork. The aim is to build professional skills for working on the complex phenomena of climate change. Graduates usually go into environmental and geoscience consulting, monitoring and public bodies, or on to a master's degree.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test; English B2. EU call 15 March–7 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Capped places filled from a ranking; see the programme's call when it opens.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €2,950 a year, by income

programmes.name: Economics, Governance and Decision-Making
programmes.about: A transdisciplinary degree in the style of Philosophy, Politics and Economics (PPE) programmes, taught in English; the first semester is entirely online.
programmes.overview: A transdisciplinary social science degree with a strong methodological stamp, paying attention to ethics and logical reasoning. The first two years are common, covering typical subjects such as economics, politics, philosophy, law, statistics and mathematics, and in the third year you orient yourself towards one of three specialised tracks. Graduates are prepared for junior and consulting positions in public and private organisations, NGOs and international organisations, or for a wide range of master's programmes in Italy and abroad.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test. EU call 9 March–9 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Capped places filled from a ranking; see the programme's call when it opens.
programmes.closesNote: Programme page: 9 April; general page: 7 April
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €2,950 a year, by income

programmes.name: Information Engineering
programmes.about: Physics and maths foundations plus the core of information engineering: control systems, electronics, telecommunications and computer science.
programmes.overview: The degree gives a broad base in the main areas of information engineering, which are automation, electronics, computer science and telecommunications, resting on physics and mathematics. A strong methodological approach to analysing problems runs through the courses, which are taught in a blended format. Typical subjects include calculus, programming, signals and systems, control and electronic circuits. Graduates develop critical analysis, design and problem-solving skills and can work in private companies, public administration or independent practice, in Italy or abroad, or continue to a master's degree in engineering.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test. EU call 9 March–9 April 2027.

programmes.name: Psychological Science
programmes.about: Psychology in English in Padua, giving theory and experimental and clinical work equal weight, with seminars and workshops.
programmes.overview: The course covers the main sectors of psychology, general, social and psychodynamic, together with the methods of scientific investigation, and gives theory and experimental and clinical work equal weight through seminars and workshops. Typical courses include general, developmental and social psychology, psychometrics, statistics and research methods. An international dimension comes from a network of partnerships with training institutions. Graduates work in psychometric and psychosocial assessment, education, human resources, business and third-sector organisations, or continue to a master's degree in psychology.
programmes.ib: Online entry test in English (details to come); English B2. EU call 9 March–9 April 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: Capped places filled from a ranking on the entry test. 55 places for EU applicants (2027/28).
programmes.closesNote: Programme page: 9 April; general page: 7 April
programmes.tuitionEuEea: Up to €2,950 a year, by income

programmes.name: Techniques and Methods in Psychological Science
programmes.about: An online psychology bachelor's in English covering the main psychological domains, taught remotely by Padua's Department of General Psychology.
programmes.overview: Delivered entirely by distance learning, the degree teaches the foundations of the main fields of psychology, the methods of scientific research, and cognitive and emotional processes together with their psychobiological bases. Typical courses include general and developmental psychology, statistics and research methods. It trains you to design intervention projects for communities, in emergencies and to improve well-being, at national and international level. Graduates work in psychological well-being services, research, training and organisational development, continuing education, and organisations dealing with migration, inclusion and human rights, or continue to a master's degree.
programmes.ib: Online entry test in English (details to come); English B2. EU call 9 March–9 April 2027.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: A six-year medical degree taught in English in Venice; places are set nationally, through a national admission test.
programmes.overview: Taught in English in Venice over six years, the course takes a holistic view of the person, with attention to health promotion, preventive medicine and global health. Learning follows integrated pathways with active student involvement, and a clinical approach begins in the first year, to prepare doctors for multicultural healthcare settings. Typical early subjects in a medical degree include anatomy, physiology and biochemistry. Graduates can enter specialist training programmes in Italy and practise in public or private healthcare facilities, independently or in teams.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English, set by the Ministry's call; 2027 dates not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the IMAT; you need the minimum score and a place in the ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Every English bachelor's has capped places and EU applicants have their own spring 2027 call; the call closing 15 November 2026 is for open-access degrees, all Italian-taught.
Padua's general page gives the EU call for English degrees as 15 March–7 April 2027, but six of the seven programme pages say 9 March–9 April 2027: check your programme's page.
Applying costs €60, or only the €55 CEnT-S fee if all your choices use CEnT-S; no Italian certificate is needed for English-taught degrees.
